summary: Jim Detterline (60), former RMNP climbing ranger ('Mr. Longs Peak,' 428 ascents), died in an accidental fall while rope soloing the 'Ironclads' formation less than a mile from his Allenspark home; last seen alive Oct 23, body found the afternoon of Oct 25 (presumed died earlier that day) with his dog Annie waiting nearby; Boulder County coroner ruled injuries consistent with a fall.
notes: One-time Climbing.com 'Climbers We Lost' cross-check (2026-10-07); 2016 list page defunct (was a Rock and Ice tribute, never migrated) — verified via CPR, Alpinist, Wikipedia; not previously indexed.
